|strategy=By [mailto:mcyi3ejw@stud.umist.ac.uk Edward Woodcock : mcyi3ejw@stud.umist.ac.uk]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/dark/small/meteorimpact.html</ref>

Play this card on the [[Wampa]] cave, targeting a major rebel who is not at the [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] Echo Command Centre(Obi Wan [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Kenobi]] or [[Commander Luke Skywalker]] work best as they cannot use their light sabres to force drain - see below), then play Responsibility of Command on the same character. Your opponent will be unable to initiate battles or force drains at the same location as a powerful character, and the only way to cancel this effect is to take a long trek over the North Ridge through Imperial territory ... and then walk back. Throw in nightfall, exhaustion, exposure and too cold for speeders for extra laughs.
|rulings=* If the targeted character moves (or is carried) through the Utinni Effect's site, it will be canceled as the character moves through.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Meteor%20Impact%3F</ref>
* The targeted character may not move (or be carried) to any location that isn't part of the same system.
* The targeted character may not move (or be carried) to the related system location or a related cloud sector.
* The targeted character may not initiate a move (or be carried) to any site of greater distance (number of adjacent sites) from the Utinni Effect than the character's current site, even if doing so would pass through the Utinni Effect and complete it.
